summary.zh-CN: 在免费的 WebGPU 网页驾驶游戏中穿行雨夜霓虹城市，体验漂移。

description.en: Anderson Mancini and Sunag present a Three.js driving game with traffic, nitro, drift scoring and a synthwave radio. A WebGPU-capable browser is required.
description.zh-CN: Anderson Mancini 与 Sunag 制作的 Three.js 驾驶游戏，包含城市车流、氮气加速、漂移计分与合成波电台，需要支持 WebGPU 的浏览器。

gameplay.en: Use W/S to accelerate and brake, A/D to steer, Space to drift and Shift for nitro. C changes the camera; Tab opens the city map.
gameplay.zh-CN: W/S 加速和刹车，A/D 转向，空格漂移，Shift 使用氮气；C 切换镜头，Tab 打开城市地图。

cover_alt.en: Threejs-Punk Drive rainy neon title screen
cover_alt.zh-CN: Threejs-Punk Drive 雨夜霓虹标题画面

ai_use.en: The checked game page and Three.js showcase do not document an AI workflow or a specific model.
ai_use.zh-CN: 已检查的游戏页面与 Three.js 展示帖未记录 AI 工作流程或具体模型。

summary.en: A browser basketball challenge with timed aiming, shot power and five shooting racks.
summary.zh-CN: 通过瞄准与力度时机挑战五组投篮点的网页三分球大赛。

description.en: Shoot from five positions in the Wildcats gym. Each rack ends with a two-point money ball; consecutive makes and quick releases offer additional scoring opportunities. Daily results are stored locally in the browser.
description.zh-CN: 在 Wildcats 体育馆的五个位置投篮，每组最后一颗为两分球；连续命中与快速出手带来更多得分机会，每日成绩保存在本地浏览器中。

creator: Uncredited on the checked public page

gameplay.en: Click to stop the aim marker, then click again to set power. Hold Shift to switch to a flatter shot arc and try to hit the green timing zones.
gameplay.zh-CN: 点击停止瞄准标记，再次点击确定力度；按住 Shift 切换为更平的抛物线，尽量命中绿色时机区域。

cover_alt.en: Three-point Contest title menu in the Wildcats basketball gym
cover_alt.zh-CN: Three-point Contest 在 Wildcats 篮球馆的标题菜单

summary.en: An arcade snowboard descent through a 3.35 km alpine valley with an 890 m drop.
summary.zh-CN: 沿 3.35 公里高山雪谷完成 890 米落差下降的街机单板滑雪游戏。

description.en: Andrew Blumson’s WebGPU snowboard game follows one mountain run through snow and forests. Land tricks to fill the boost meter and trigger RUSH. The game requires a desktop WebGPU browser and supports keyboard and gamepad controls.
description.zh-CN: Andrew Blumson 制作的 WebGPU 单板滑雪游戏，沿单条山地路线穿越积雪与森林；成功落地的技巧动作积累加速能量并触发 RUSH。游戏需要桌面端 WebGPU 浏览器，支持键盘与手柄。

gameplay.en: Start a mountain run, steer the snowboard down the valley, land tricks and use boost to reach the finish faster.
gameplay.zh-CN: 开始山地滑行，控制单板沿雪谷下降，完成技巧动作积累加速，以更快速度到达终点。

cover_alt.en: Powder Rush title screen with a snowboarder on a snowy mountain
cover_alt.zh-CN: Powder Rush 雪山单板滑雪标题画面

ai_use.en: The public in-game credits state that music, the announcer and every sound effect were made with ElevenLabs. They do not identify a specific model or verify AI programming.
ai_use.zh-CN: 公开游戏制作名单说明音乐、播报员与全部音效使用 ElevenLabs 制作，但未注明具体模型，也未证实 AI 编程。

summary.en: A WebGPU destruction sandbox where about 94,000 city voxels are individual rigid bodies.
summary.zh-CN: 约 9.4 万个城市体素分别参与刚体模拟的 WebGPU 破坏沙盒。

description.en: This open-source Three.js demo uses the three-avbd GPU solver for destructible city buildings, a voxel race track and a zero-gravity space station. Cut supports, shatter glass and watch debris settle; compatible mobile browsers have touch controls.
description.zh-CN: 这款开源 Three.js 演示使用 three-avbd GPU 求解器，提供可破坏城市、体素赛道与零重力空间站。切断支撑、打碎玻璃并观察碎片沉降；兼容的手机浏览器提供触控操作。

gameplay.en: Move with WASD and use the mouse to aim and operate tools. Switch between hammer, laser, rockets, charges and wrecking ball; F toggles flying and walking, and R resets the scene.
gameplay.zh-CN: WASD 移动，鼠标瞄准并使用工具；切换锤子、激光、火箭、炸药与破坏球，F 切换飞行和步行，R 重置场景。

cover_alt.en: Voxel City browser sandbox with towers and a rocket launcher
cover_alt.zh-CN: Voxel City 网页沙盒中的高楼与火箭发射器

ai_use.en: The public repository describes the physics and controls but does not document an AI workflow or model.

summary.en: A free browser demo of a retro first-person shooter set in an alien-invaded city.
summary.zh-CN: 外星入侵城市题材的复古第一人称射击游戏，提供免费网页试玩。

description.en: Play as Nova Velryn, leave the hotel and fight aliens with firearms and unusual gadgets. The free demo has marked boundaries; the complete downloadable edition is paid. Desktop WebGL 2 and keyboard/mouse or an Xbox controller are supported.
description.zh-CN: 扮演 Nova Velryn，从酒店进入城市，使用枪械与奇特道具对抗外星人。免费试玩区域设有边界，完整下载版付费；支持桌面 WebGL 2、键鼠或 Xbox 手柄。

gameplay.en: Click Run game, then Enter the game. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse, fire with left click, use E to interact or enter vehicles, and press Esc or Tab to pause.
gameplay.zh-CN: 点击 Run game，再点击 Enter the game；WASD 移动，鼠标瞄准，左键攻击，E 互动或进入载具，Esc 或 Tab 暂停。
